    static long fastPower(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1L;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;

    static long modularInverse(long x) {
        return fastPower(x, mod - 2);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
